kozak.name: Kozak consensus (GCCACC before ATG)
kozak.source: Kozak M. (1987) Nucleic Acids Res 15:8125-8148 (optimal translation-initiation context).
kozak.relevance: Placed immediately 5' of the start codon to strengthen translation initiation in eukaryotes.
kozak.uncertainty: Consensus context; optimal context can vary by transcript and host.

five_utr.name: Minimal synthetic 5' UTR (placeholder)
five_utr.relevance: A short, structure-light 5' leader to allow scanning; placeholder only.
five_utr.uncertainty: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER; not experimentally validated. Replace with a source-backed UTR (e.g. a validated HBB 5' UTR) or user-supplied sequence for real use.

three_utr.name: Minimal synthetic 3' UTR (placeholder)
three_utr.relevance: A short 3' UTR placeholder; many therapeutic mRNAs use stabilizing 3' UTRs (e.g. tandem beta-globin).
three_utr.uncertainty: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER; not experimentally validated. Replace with a source-backed 3' UTR or user-supplied sequence for real use.
